cloud_byte_verification.method: Reconstructed Git blob/tree hashes from tested local bytes plus verified immutable base tree entries

coverage: Independent list and map/successor oracles across 200 worlds
World identity preserved across length/position variants; counterfactual answers differ
Gold excluded from prompts; oracle arms explicitly labeled
Formatting and abstention separated from semantic correctness
Future/padding evidence exclusion, masked NaNs, batch and request isolation
Zero-output identity and first-step output-gradient liveness
Controller gradient liveness after explicit output perturbation
Matched tied-read initialization and exact parameter counts
Toy full/cached parity and intentionally broken-cache rejection
Later-token bias divergence rejects invalid saved-prefix reuse
Changing snapshots, LFS pointers, symlinks, invalid JSON and overwrites rejected

audit.limitations: Two renderers; no held-out language or structural generalization claim

negative_cli_checks.unreviewed_native_contract_output: BLOCKED: A separately reviewed frozen-only native contract is required

next_required_action: Independently inventory/review actual R2 assets and runtime; qualify frozen full/cached behavior before the open-DEV ladder. Native QRR qualification and training are separate later stages.

parameter_audit.warning: Equal stored parameters do not imply equal training or inference work

unit_tests.scope: Only the new isolated programme; not the full repository regression suite
